comment: What the matrix has actually proven, not what a peer range claims. runtimes are read from each fixture's installed tree. Update only from a green run. Module counts are deliberately not recorded: they drift between runs with the installed set and Metro cache, so they would be false precision.

assertions.peers: check-peers.mjs — every peer in the installed tree is satisfied
assertions.bundle: expo export --platform android — the react-native export condition (src, for inertia)
assertions.bundle:web: expo export --platform web — the import condition (dist)
assertions.range: check-range.mjs — the declared range admits only combinations that exist

@rootnative/components.range: FAIL · 6 over-promises. Advertises react >=18.0.0 and react-native >=0.72.0 while depending on inertia, whose floor is react >=19.0.0 and react-native >=0.81.0. npm rejects the advertised floor with ERESOLVE.
